answers.question: Before the specifics - what is a piece of work you enjoyed recently, and what made it good? A couple of sentences is plenty, no need to polish it.
I didn't see a Master's or PhD in Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field on your CV—have you done that kind of study?
Your CV doesn't mention working three days a week in the Berlin office—has that been part of your experience?
Can you tell me more about your role as an engineering manager with 13 years in mobile and embedded software?
What does your experience as an engineering manager with 13 years in mobile and embedded software involve?
Could you explain what that dash refers to on your CV?
